name: session-strip
description: Publishes each Claude Code session's synopsis (project, task, tools running) and id for an on-screen strip

useHaiku.title: Summarize the task with Haiku
useHaiku.description: One tiny Haiku call (~$0.0006) writes the title for each prompt you send, once Claude has started to answer. On a long task it is rewritten as the work changes gears. Off: the task is the first prompt, truncated.

longTaskAfterMinutes.title: A long task starts after N minutes
longTaskAfterMinutes.description: Once this long has passed since your last prompt, the title is refreshed on the interval below.

summarizeEveryMinutes.title: Re-summarize a long task every N minutes
summarizeEveryMinutes.description: Checked when a tool call or a turn finishes; an idle session is never re-summarized.
